qa_pairs.question: What was the subject of the CANHEIT 2019 presentation on June 20, 2019?
qa_pairs.answer: The CANHEIT 2019 presentation on June 20, 2019, was titled "Providing A Unified User Environment for Canada’s National Advanced Computing Centers."

qa_pairs.question: In which proceedings can one find the article "Providing a Unified Software Environment for Canada’s National Advanced Computing Centers"?
qa_pairs.answer: The article "Providing a Unified Software Environment for Canada’s National Advanced Computing Centers" can be found in the Proceedings of the Practice and Experience in Advanced Research Computing '19, published on July 28, 2019. A PDF version is also available.
